(4) The Secretary General shall be entitled to be present,
speak and vote, at any meeting of the Commission, or any
other Committee established under this Act.
(5)  The  Secretary  General  shall  ensure  that  sufficient
transparency  is  maintained  in  carrying  out  his  duties  and
functions.
(6) The Secretary General shall submit to the Commission,
the three years work plan, the annual plan and programme
and the annual budget, for its concurrence.
(7) The Secretary General may be paid such remuneration
in such manner and at such rates as may be determined by
the Minister with the concurrence of the Minister assigned
the subject of finance.

17.
(1) The Minister shall appoint a person who shall
have ten years of academic or professional experience in the
fields  of  education,  natural  science,  social  and  human
science,  culture,  communication  or  administration  as  the
Deputy Secretary General of the Commission.
(2) The Deputy Secretary General shall assist the Secretary
General to exercise, perform and discharge the powers, duties
and functions the Commission.
(3)  The  Deputy  Secretary  General  may  be  paid  such
remuneration in such manner and at such rates as may be
determined  by  the  Minister  with  the  concurrence  of  the
Minister assigned the subject of finance.

18.
(1) The Secretary General and the Deputy Secretary
General shall hold office for a period of three years and shall
be eligible for re-appointment.
(2)  The  Minister  may  for  reasons  assigned  remove  the
Secretary  General  or  the  Deputy  Secretary  General  from
office.
